newsitem.title: CHINA: China province lacks water to build reservoirs.
newsitem.headline: China province lacks water to build reservoirs.

text.p: Authorities in China's eastern province of Zhejiang will increase utility rates to raise funds to build reservoirs to resolve a water shortage, which caused 1.5 billion yuan ($181 million) in economic losses in 1995, the Xinhua news agency said.

Half of the 70 towns in the booming province were short of water because industrial pollution, rapid population growth and poor water storage facilities had cut into water supplies, the agency said late on Thursday.
Provincial authorities would allow local water departments to raise water rates by 0.20 to 0.50 yuan ($0.024 to $0.06) per cubic metre to raise funds for building new reservoirs, it said.
Preferential treatment on land use and tax would be given to reservoir projects, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
